scopedComparisons.originalDigitalComparatorVersion: ਨਮੋ ਗੀਤ ਗੀਤੇ ॥ ਨਮੋ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤੇ ॥ ਨਮੋ ਰੋਖ ਰੋਖੇ ॥ ਨਮੋ ਸੋਖ ਸੋਖੇ ॥੬੮॥
ਨਮੋ ਜੀਵ ਜੀਵੰ ਨਮੋ ਬੀਜ ਬੀਜੇ ॥ ਅਖਿੱਜੇ ਅਭਿੱਜੇ ॥ ਸਮਸਤੰ ਪ੍ਰਸਿੱਜੇ ॥੭੨॥
ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੰ ਸਰੂਪੇ ਕੁਕਰਮੰ ਪ੍ਰਣਾਸੀ ॥ ਸਦਾ ਸਰਬਦਾ ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧੰ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ॥੭੩॥
ਚਰਪਟ ਛੰਦ ॥ ਤ੍ਵਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕਰਮੇ ॥ ਅੰਬ੍ਰਿਤ ਧਰਮੇ ॥ ਅਖਿਲ ਜੋਗੇ ॥ ਅਚਲ ਭੋਗੇ ॥੭੪॥
ਅਚਲ ਰਾਜੇ ॥ ਅਟਲ ਸਾਜੇ ॥ ਅਖਲ ਧਰਮੰ ॥ ਅਲਖ ਕਰਮੰ ॥੭੫॥

sourceIntegrity.metricalScope: The existing Bhujang Prayat section continues through73. Frozen74 has a separate ਚਰਪਟ ਛੰਦ ॥ ਤ੍ਵ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥ heading, then four verse lines;75 continues that form. The heading is not counted among the31 explanations.

references.title: Bhai Kahn Singh Nabha — Mahan Kosh, headword ਰੋਖ
references.locator: Mahan Kosh definition, sense3, citing ਨਮੋ ਰੋਖ ਰੋਖੇ; distinguish the separately labelled Bhai Maya Singh entry
references.scope: The exact Jaap citation occurs under martial ardour/ਜੋਸ਼. Anger and opposition are listed separately; the main draft therefore does not reduce the epithet to uncontrolled rage.

references.title: Bhai Kahn Singh Nabha — Mahan Kosh, headword ਅੰਬ੍ਰਿਤ
references.locator: Senses2–3, including exact Jaap citation ਅੰਬ੍ਰਿਤ ਧਰਮੇ; separate initial cross-reference to ਅਮ੍ਰਿਤ
references.scope: Supports unobstructed/unbroken independently of the neighbouring deathlessness word. No spelling substitution or unverified etymology is required.

references.title: Bhai Kahn Singh Nabha — Mahan Kosh, headword ਅਖਲ, hosted by Punjabi University
references.locator: Mahan Kosh first sense ਅਖਿਲ/all/whole; distinct later senses excluded; Hazara Singh entry also gives ਸਮੂਹ
references.accessMode: Direct HTML dictionary entries with their separate attributions
references.scope: Supports all-inclusive union and universal dharam. The entry does not by itself resolve the exact ਅਖੱਲ/ਅਖਿਲ Jaap source variation.

references.title: Bhai Kahn Singh Nabha — Mahan Kosh, headword ਤ੍ਰਿਭੰਗੀ
references.locator: Mahan Kosh sense2, which cites ਤ੍ਰਿਭੰਗੀ ਅਨੰਗੇ (Jaap); separate posture and metre senses excluded
references.scope: The specifically cited alternative concerns the three gunas, named as sattva, rajas and tamas. It is not collapsed into the selected three-world dissolution of the Punjabi steeks.

references.title: Bhai Kahn Singh Nabha — Mahan Kosh, headword ਅਭਿਜ
references.locator: Sense3 cites ਅਖਿੱਜੇ ਅਭਿੱਜੇ (Jaap) and refers to ਅਭਿਗ sense3; preceding not-wet/not-softened senses are distinct
references.scope: Provides a concrete knowledge-related alternative at72.03 rather than a speculative derivation from the modern-looking spelling.

references.title: Bhai Kahn Singh Nabha — Mahan Kosh, headword ਅਭਿਗ
references.locator: Mahan Kosh sense3 at the end of the combined dictionary page, not the earlier general SGGS dictionary senses
references.scope: Completes the ਅਭਿਜ cross-reference: fully knowing or well acquainted. The different unattached/impassive senses are not silently merged with it.

references.title: Historical dictionary entries for ਤਾਨ: Mahan Kosh and Bhai Maya Singh
references.locator: Mahan Kosh definition and separately labelled THE PANJABI DICTIONARY — Bhai Maya Singh entry
references.accessMode: Direct HTML with attribution boundaries inspected
references.scope: The explicit power/strength gloss is in Bhai Maya Singh. The Mahan entry primarily discusses expansion, music and other senses, including a ਤ੍ਰਾਣ cross-reference. No claim that its music discussion alone proves the70 reading.

references.title: SriGranth combined dictionaries, headword ਸੋਖ
references.locator: Punjabi-English/Hindi definition gives drying; Mahan Kosh cross-references ਸੋਸ and gives additional separately numbered senses
references.accessMode: Direct HTML dictionary page; attributions kept distinct
references.scope: Supports the drying vocabulary behind the selected dissolution interpretation. It is not silently equated with ਸੁਖ; the universal-dissolution scope comes from the Jaap commentaries.

references.title: Bhai Maya Singh — The Panjabi Dictionary, headword ਸੋਸ
references.locator: The separately attributed historical dictionary definition
references.scope: Drying, drying up and absorption. This is not labelled as a Mahan Kosh definition simply because the website has a general Mahan Kosh title.

references.title: Bhai Kahn Singh Nabha — Mahan Kosh, headword ਜੰਤ੍ਰ, hosted by Punjabi University
references.locator: Mahan Kosh senses2–4; other headword senses remain distinct
references.scope: Instrument/device and ritual uses support distinguishing jantra from utterance. No ritual procedure or claim of efficacy is taken from the entry.

references.title: Rattan Singh Jaggi — Sikh Panth Vishwakosh, headword ਮੰਤ੍ਰ, hosted by Punjabi University
references.locator: Opening definition and contextual discussion of mantra; author/source attribution on the entry
references.scope: Used narrowly for sacred/formulaic utterance and historical context. The educational draft supplies neither occult methods nor promised effects.

references.title: Sri Guru Granth Kosh, Hazara Singh tradition, headword ਰਿਧਿ, hosted by Punjabi University
references.locator: Senses1–2: growth/prosperity and powers associated with yogic attainment; exact source attribution preserved
references.scope: Supports both the abundance component and the traditional extraordinary-power register of the pair. It is not evidence that such powers have been empirically established.

references.title: Bhai Kahn Singh Nabha — Mahan Kosh, headword ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ

references.scope: Lexical support for deathlessness, while the specific deeds interpretation is checked against Punjabi commentary. Does not establish a physical immortality promise.

references.title: Bhai Kahn Singh Nabha — Mahan Kosh, headword ਚਰਪਟ, hosted by Punjabi University
references.locator: Mahan Kosh sense5, the metre, with Jaap examples; separate yogi/person and other headword senses excluded
references.scope: Corroborates the metre name and compact paired form. Its quotation has its own spelling differences; no replacement scripture or exact pronunciation/beat rule is supplied.

sourceChecks.workingReading: Same song image and exact earlier bilingual main wording as47.03
sourceChecks.finding: Compared directly with the existing course.v12 note, not merely with a new rephrasing. The changed neighbouring images do not justify silently changing the repeated main explanation.

sourceChecks.workingReading: Deepest love or supreme loving One
alternatives: Punjabi commentary also expresses the supreme lover among those who love
sourceChecks.finding: The shared love sense is selected while the frozen ਪ੍ਰੀਤ versus consulted ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ spelling flag remains visible.

sourceChecks.workingReading: Supreme fierce ardour or resolve
alternatives: Anger/wrath emphasis in Neki and the dictionary’s other senses
sourceChecks.finding: The Mahan Kosh exact Jaap citation occurs under martial ardour. The main avoids reducing the epithet to personal emotional rage; no licence for violence is implied.

sourceChecks.workingReading: Drying or absorption, extended contextually to gathering all creation into dissolution
alternatives: Neki’s drought image
Bhai Vir Singh-derived drying even dryness
sourceChecks.finding: The drying lexical facts and the commentaries’ wider dissolution interpretation are kept separate. The word is not normalised to ਸੁਖ.

sourceChecks.workingReading: All illness remains within the comprehensive Divine address
alternatives: Neki gives source of ailments
Bhai Vir Singh-derived commentary offers breaking/removing and sovereignty over suffering
sourceChecks.finding: The main is an explicitly educational paraphrase of the all-illness form, not a diagnosis, cure guarantee or claim about an individual’s moral worth. Earlier55 ਰੋਗ ਹਰਤਾ is not substituted.

sourceChecks.workingReading: Enjoyer of all creation
alternatives: Form of bliss in another emphasis
sourceChecks.finding: Enjoyment remains distinct from the earlier denial of dependence on enjoyment. No instruction to pursue excess is inferred.

sourceChecks.workingReading: Prevailing over all and inspiring fear/awe
sourceChecks.finding: Both universal epithets retained. ਭੀਤੰ is not the separate fearlessness term ਅਭੀਤ; neither word grants human dominion or intimidation rights.

sourceChecks.workingReading: Fullness and source of all knowledge
alternatives: Punjabi wording varies between knowledge-form and giver of knowledge
sourceChecks.finding: A modest educational synthesis of close readings, not a claim of human omniscience.

sourceChecks.workingReading: Supreme strength
alternatives: Neki reads all-attracting
sourceChecks.finding: Strength is independently supported and distinguished from47’s musical ਤਾਨ. The dictionary attribution for the explicit power gloss is Bhai Maya Singh, not the Mahan musical entry.

sourceChecks.workingReading: All-mantra source and substance; sacred utterance or teaching
alternatives: Bhai Vir Singh-derived emphasis on wisdom and devotional utterance
sourceChecks.finding: The wording is devotional, not an operational spell or medical practice.

sourceChecks.workingReading: Power at work through instruments and means
alternatives: Punjabi steeks retain all-jantra form
Neki emphasises spells
sourceChecks.finding: The selected means-related explanation is specifically attributed to the Bhai Vir Singh-derived account. Instrument/device senses are checked in Mahan Kosh. No supernatural mechanism or guaranteed effect is asserted.

sourceChecks.workingReading: All-seeing and all-attracting
alternatives: Bhai Vir Singh-derived seeing also includes looking after
Neki uses supreme power for the second epithet
sourceChecks.finding: Seeing is devotional comprehensive awareness, not a ranking of physical sensory ability. No speculative etymology or proper-name replacement is introduced for ਕ੍ਰਿੱਸੰ.

sourceChecks.workingReading: Present through all colours and delight
sourceChecks.finding: Both colour and bliss associations in the Punjabi witnesses are retained; no complexion or sensory hierarchy is implied.

sourceChecks.workingReading: Dissolver of the three worlds, without a bodily limit
alternatives: Mahan Kosh specifically cites the phrase under the three-guna sense: sattva, rajas and tamas
sourceChecks.finding: Both ਤ੍ਰਿਭੰਗੀ and ਅਨੰਗੇ explained. Neki’s compressed ending alone does not supply a separate bodiless gloss. The dictionary’s posture and metre meanings are not automatically transferred into this line.

sourceChecks.workingReading: Life within beings and originating potential of seeds
alternatives: Cause beneath causes and germinating power are close emphases in the Punjabi witnesses
sourceChecks.finding: Life and seed remain distinct images. No agricultural guarantee or biological mechanism is invented.

sourceChecks.workingReading: Unprovoked and unattached beside compassion toward all
alternatives: Mahan ਅਭਿਜ exact Jaap citation cross-refers to fully knowing at ਅਭਿਗ sense3
Bhai Vir Singh-derived undivided wholeness
Sewa states not irritated/not softened beside compassion
sourceChecks.finding: The selected nonattachment reading is provisional. The dictionary’s specifically cited knowledge sense and the other readings remain visible rather than merged. The final universal compassion is not omitted or replaced by indifference.

sourceChecks.workingReading: Compassionate nature and ending wrongful actions
sourceChecks.finding: ਕੁਕਰਮੰ is the object of ending, not a category of people to be attacked. Compassion and ethical change remain linked.

sourceChecks.workingReading: Abiding home of abundance and spiritual powers, always and everywhere
alternatives: ਸਦਾ ਸਰਬਦਾ primarily stresses continuing presence; the inspected Punjabi chapter also gives all places
sourceChecks.finding: Every main part of the long line is retained: duration, comprehensive presence, ਰਿਧਿ, ਸਿਧੰ and dwelling. The traditional extraordinary-power sense is acknowledged without proof, technique or promise.

sourceChecks.workingReading: Charpat heading and grace invocation precede four brief descriptions
sourceChecks.finding: The heading is metadata, not a fifth line. Its exact frozen Gurmukhi and hash are anchored separately. No independently unverified metre-count or santhiya rule is taught.

sourceChecks.workingReading: Deathless deeds
alternatives: Sewa stresses making immortal
Neki emphasises nectar-like deeds
sourceChecks.finding: Selected interpretation of ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿੱਤ ਕਰਮੇ is marked provisional. Neither bodily immortality nor permanent created forms are promised.

sourceChecks.workingReading: Unbroken and unobstructed dharam
alternatives: The dictionary separately cross-refers ਅੰਬ੍ਰਿਤ to ਅਮ੍ਰਿਤ in another sense
sourceChecks.finding: Mahan Kosh gives the exact Jaap citation under unobstructed/unbroken. The source ਅੰਬ੍ਰਿਤ is never rewritten or automatically conflated with the first line’s ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿੱਤ.

sourceChecks.workingReading: Joined with all creation
alternatives: Bhai Vir Singh-derived main stresses unwavering union, with a union-with-everyone note
Neki describes blissful yoga
sourceChecks.finding: The source ਅਖੱਲ and another consulted text’s ਅਖਿਲ remain distinct spellings. The all-inclusive sense has dictionary and contextual support, but this does not resolve the source-edition flag.

sourceChecks.workingReading: Enduring or unfailing provision
alternatives: Bhai Vir Singh-derived enduring enjoyment/bliss
Neki enduring rule
sourceChecks.finding: The Punjabi supplies/stores reading is selected. Alternative enjoyment and sovereignty readings are not silently blended into the main explanation.

sourceChecks.workingReading: Unshakable sovereignty and steadfast creative power
alternatives: Bhai Vir Singh-derived second line describes a stable Creator
sourceChecks.finding: The two epithets remain distinct. The creative-power reading avoids declaring each material form physically permanent.

sourceChecks.workingReading: Universal dharam
alternatives: All dharams in the Punjabi chapter and Bhai Vir Singh-derived explanation
Neki emphasises unhindered laws
sourceChecks.finding: The all/whole sense is selected without changing frozen ਅਖੱਲ. Differences among human traditions are not erased, and no claim that every practice is equally wise is made.

sourceChecks.workingReading: Divine deeds beyond full perception or comprehension
alternatives: Punjabi readings emphasise unseen deeds or wondrous activity
sourceChecks.finding: ਅਲੱਖ is kept distinct from neighbouring ਅਖੱਲ. Divine mystery is not used to excuse human wrongdoing or block accountability.

independentEditorialUncertainties.issue: Fierce ardour/wrath and drying/dissolution are related but not interchangeable poetic choices.
independentEditorialUncertainties.treatment: Select the exact dictionary-cited ardour and Punjabi dissolution readings; retain the alternatives and avoid a claim that these English paraphrases are literal translations.

independentEditorialUncertainties.issue: All-illness form, source of ailments and breaking/removing readings differ.
independentEditorialUncertainties.treatment: Keep the selected inclusive Divine address explicit and avoid diagnosing illness, assigning moral blame or claiming a cure.

independentEditorialUncertainties.issue: Punjabi strength versus Neki attraction at ਪਰਮ ਤਾਨੰ.
independentEditorialUncertainties.treatment: Strength selected from contextual commentary and historical dictionary support; earlier47 musical sense remains unchanged.

independentEditorialUncertainties.issue: Three-world dissolution in the Punjabi steeks versus a specifically cited three-guna reading in Mahan Kosh.
independentEditorialUncertainties.treatment: Keep both source-specific readings visible, explain ਅਨੰਗੇ independently, and require qualified review before claiming a settled translation.

independentEditorialUncertainties.issue: ਅਭਿੱਜੇ has materially different unattached/unmoved, fully-knowing and undivided readings.
independentEditorialUncertainties.treatment: Selected main is clearly provisional; Mahan exact citation and cross-reference are recorded rather than ignored. Compassion in72.04 remains explicit.

independentEditorialUncertainties.issue: Duration in ਸਦਾ ਸਰਬਦਾ and the Punjabi witness’s spatial expansion must be distinguished; riddhi/siddhi carries a historical extraordinary-power register.
independentEditorialUncertainties.treatment: Retain duration, place, abundance, attainment/power and dwelling without promising occult abilities or collapsing the long line into a generic moral statement.

independentEditorialUncertainties.issue: Deathless versus immortalising/nectar-like action, ਅੰਬ੍ਰਿਤ’s separate sense, source ਅਖੱਲ versus consulted ਅਖਿਲ, and provision versus enjoyment/rule.
independentEditorialUncertainties.treatment: Keep all four selected meanings bounded and the alternatives visible. No source normalisation or physical immortality inference.

independentEditorialUncertainties.issue: Universal dharam versus all dharams or unhindered laws.
independentEditorialUncertainties.treatment: Select the all/whole reading with lexical support, retain Neki’s different emphasis, and avoid claiming uniformity of all human traditions.

inspectionLimits: This author directly read retrieved PDF text layers, including legacy-font Punjabi, and directly opened the cited HTML dictionary entries. No visual source-edition, printed-manuscript or santhiya collation is claimed.

The Vidhia-hosted chapter gives direct Punjabi commentary, but its title-page authorship was not independently inspected. It is cited as a chapter witness rather than as independently verified author attribution.

The SikhTranslations page is a modern English presentation of Bhai Vir Singh commentary, not direct collation against the original Punjabi edition. Its alternative glosses and spelling differences are kept identifiable.

Exact dictionary routes for doubled-form ਅਭਿੱਜ and ਅਖਿੱਜ were not reliably retrievable. The separately located ਅਭਿਜ entry and its directly checked ਅਭਿਗ sense3 cross-reference support the noted alternative; the selected ਅਖਿੱਜੇ sense uses the directly read commentaries.
The original two-site ledger retains five flags in68–75 and67 across the complete source. Digital-site lineage, source edition, rights and qualified Sikh/Punjabi approval remain unresolved.

authoringMethod.sourcesUsedFor: Short lexical checks and explicit alternatives; close-reading connections, cautions, reflection and teach-back prompts are original educational prose. Modern verse translations are not reproduced.
